notes.title: Skater Cally - New Cally game out in September!
notes.notes:
Skater Cally is the new Cally game, set to hit steam in September 2018.  It's a 2d arcade Skateboarding game that has a deep combo system.   It has been really fun to work on a different genre of game for the first time since we started making games!  

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11011368/83899607f9611d8ab503f9b58bf0411577b83f43.gif[/img]

Right now we are running a small beta until the end of August, if you want to be a part of it, come join the [url=https://discord.gg/bDvBWhK] Cally Discord and hit us up!	[/url]

notes.title: Cally Games on Sale in Steam Winter Sale & Cally's Caves 4 Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Cally's Caves 3 and Cally's Trials are on sale for 80% off during the Steam Winter Sale.  In addition to this, Glass Wing, a game by CC contributor Sayuri is also on sale, and to celebrate, Sayuri made this awesome image of Cally and Mayfly having some snacks! 

[img]https://i0.wp.com/callyscaves.files.wordpress.com/2016/12/milk-and-orange-slices.png[/img]

We also want to let everyone know that we are working our butts off on Cally's Caves 4, and that it will be out sometime in 2017.  We are overwhelmed by the support for the Cally games, and are doing our best to make the best Cally game yet!  
Thanks to the Steam Community, and a huge thanks to Valve for letting us sell our game on Steam!
Jordan & OHKO

notes.title: Cally's Trials releasing June 14th
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
We just wanted to let you know that Cally's Caves 2  is coming to steam as "Cally's Trials" On June 14th.  Cally's Trials puts a roguelike spin on Cally's Caves 2, and in the process of upgrading it for PC we added a ton of new stuff - including controller support, button mapping, and graphics options.  You can find a more detailed look at the changes we made [url=https://callyscaves.com/2016/06/04/development-diary-22-callys-trials/] here.	[/url]

And check out the trailer with music from Ryan Hemsworth and UVboi:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UbhO4DbbskM

notes.title: First Bugfix Update is out!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
Thanks for a great first 10 days on Steam!  We've just released a bug fix patch to address the issues you've told us about.  In today's patch everyone should see:

 - improved menu response times
 - 100 bat achievement should be fixed (If you've already gotten the achievement it should award it to you once you enter the first level after the backyard level)
- pause issues during boss fight messing up camera
- game not starting (this bug may persist for some users still - we are working on a permanent solution)

We've also posted a discussion thread related to bugs, so if you have any issues please post there and rest assured that we will be working on fixing it immediately!
Thanks,
Jordan

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Cally's Caves 3, 15% off!
notes.notes:
Cally's Caves 3 is Now Available on Steam and is 15% off!*

Cally's parents have been abducted, as her arch-enemy Herbert has taken control of the Caves to perform his evil experiments. Join Cally and her friends in this action-packed run and gun platformer, conquering insane bosses, exploring to find secrets, and levelling up EVERYTHING.

Use your weapons to level them up and evolve them into their ultimate forms! Unlock new character abilities like the Triple Jump, Dodge Roll and Water Wings. Use a second playable character, Bera to unleash crazy awesome ninja moves and solve challenging puzzles. Most importantly, battle to rescue your parents from Herbert's clutches, and bring an end to Herbert's experiments for good!

*Offer ends January 12 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Cally's Caves 3 Fan Art Steam Key Giveaway!!
notes.notes:
With the release of Cally’s Caves 3 on Steam coming in less than one week, we are running a fan-art competition for Steam Keys!

The Rules:

Anyone that creates an original piece of fan-art for Cally’s Caves 3, and sends it to jordanfwc@gmail.com will get a reply email with a Steam Key for the Deluxe Edition of Cally’s Caves 3.  As long as you send it to us before January 4th, you qualify.  So get drawing and send it to us before the Steam version of Cally’s Caves 3 comes out next Tuesday!  Our favorite entry will also receive a copy of Rocket League on Steam :)

[b] Hey Everyone!	[/b]
We've finally released our demo and OST on Steam!  you can get the demo right now for free.  Although the Soundtrack is available for purchase now, there is a deluxe version that includes the soundtrack, which will be available when the main game is released.  We hope you enjoy the demo and we are looking forward to release on Jan 5th! 
Jordan and the Cally's Caves team
